summary: PRF Technologies disclosed receipt on September 24, 2026 of a letter from S.H.N. Financial Investments Ltd., holder of roughly 5.7% of voting rights, requisitioning a special general meeting to remove all directors except the external directors and elect three S.H.N. nominees. The Israeli company, listed via Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K), said it is reviewing the demand and weighing next steps; no board recommendation, advisor, or meeting date was given. Watch for the convening notice, quorum and voting thresholds, cumulative-voting mechanics, and any settlement or proxy contest timeline.
